rows.en: ＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿００１G-good morning. I'm sorry￥to bother you so early.＝＠１８６＿００２There's just something I really￥wanted to ask you...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿００３It's about the exam... What￥happened to you this time?＝＠１８６＿００４You didn't seem to do￥very well...
I was just off my game.
I was just off my game.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿００７I know how hard you always work.＝＠１８６＿００８So I thought maybe...￥something had happened...＝＠１８６＿００９I'm sorry. I worried￥for nothing.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０１２Um... please do your best.＝＠１８６＿０１３What you're doing now is for￥your own sake, nobody else's.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０１４Well then... um...￥I'm sorry for intruding on￥your day off.
